'''Mārtiņš Roze''' (28 September 1964 – 8 September 2012)<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.tvnet.lv/zinas/latvija/435279-miris_bijusais_zemkopibas_ministrs_martins_roze|title=Miris bijušais zemkopības ministrs Mārtiņš Roze|date=8 September 2012|publisher=Tvnet.lv|language=Latvian|accessdate=8 September 2012}}</ref> was a [[Latvia]]n politician. From 2002 till 2009 he was [[Minister for Agriculture of Latvia]]. He was member of [[Latvian Farmers' Union]]. He graduated from the [[University of Latvia]].
